subject: Software Engineering
moduleTitle: Unit 1 — Introduction to System Analysis, Modelling Paradigms & SDLC Methodologies
moduleDescription: Foundational concepts of general systems theory, system analysis vs. system design, system constraints and invariant characteristics, the cybernetic feedback loop, multi-dimensional system classification, Computer-Based Information Systems (CBIS) taxonomy, system modelling abstraction principles (schematic, static structural, dynamic behavioral), and a comprehensive comparative analysis of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) models (Waterfall, V-Model, Boehm's Spiral, Iterative Prototyping, and Agile Scrum).
